scientific_integrity: The infinite proof uses connected-triple patterns, exact fixed-face orbit counts, Lefschetz theory and equivariant Alexander duality. Finite code independently tests formulas but is not substituted for the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: Reflection traces in top rational homology for squared cycles of length at least nine. Previously known rotation traces and nonequivariant degree concentration are external inputs. No integral D_n-module decomposition, higher cycle powers or equivariant homotopy equivalence is claimed.
title: Reflection characters of squared-cycle three-cut homology
